checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Preserves all seven seconds of original footage unchanged
must.why: No mixed video was delivered; only a separate 15 s WAV. The original is untouched but the user gets no combined clip.

must.item: Tense instrumental bed audible, no singing
must.why: A 15 s WAV with sound exists, but I can't hear it. The assistant also said it had not listened to it.

must.item: Original radio calls remain present and synced, 'Rook, you with me?' intelligible
must.why: The deliverable is music only and has no radio calls. The user must mix it themselves, so nothing is delivered to check.

must.item: Music perceptibly below voice during every spoken line
must.why: No mix was made, so no ducking or level balance exists. Only manual advice was given.

must.item: Music audible but subordinate, not muted
must.why: The track has sound at a peak of -1 dB, which is loud, but there is no mix to judge.

faults.what: No mixed video was delivered; the user asked for music added under the clip and got only a standalone 15 s WAV with manual mixing steps.
The track is 15 s against a 7 s clip and peaks at -1 dB, so it is loud and needs trimming. The assistant never listened to it.
The earlier turn said the tools couldn't mix, which is honest, but the request is still unmet.

summary: The agent was honest that it can't mix and delivered only a separate 15 s instrumental WAV (peak -1 dB, unheard), so the requested clip with a ducked music bed under the radio calls was never produced.
